ui_fps.description: UI update rate used outside REALTIME frame scheduling.

ui_static_entry_point.description: Page entered when transitioning into STATIC mode.

rtos_tick_hz.description: ThreadX tick frequency configured at build time.

rtos_power_quiesce_timeout_ticks.description: Maximum ticks to wait for quiesce acknowledgements before timeout.

rtos_display_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thDisplay queue receive loop.

rtos_storage_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thStorage queue receive loop.

rtos_input_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thInput queue receive loop.

rtos_game_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thGame queue receive loop outside REALTIME cadence waits.

rtos_audio_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thAudio queue receive loop.

rtos_sensor_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thSensor queue receive loop.

sensor_recovery_max_attempts.description: Maximum bounded probe attempts before marking a sensor FAULT.

sensor_recovery_backoff_ticks.description: Backoff delay between sensor recovery attempts while RECOVERING.

sensor_fault_retry_ticks.description: Retry delay before attempting to recover a sensor marked FAULT.

sensor_bus_recovery_scl_pulses.description: Number of SCL pulses used during sensor I2C bus recovery when SDA is stuck low.

sensor_pmic_guard_enable.description: Enable PMIC low-voltage guard that forces ISOFET off below cutoff threshold.

sensor_pmic_poll_period_ms.description: Polling period for PMIC battery/fault monitoring in thSensor.

sensor_lis_stream_poll_period_ms.description: Polling period for LIS live stream sampling when stream mode is enabled in STATIC/REALTIME.

sensor_lis_step_status_poll_period_ms.description: Polling period for LIS step/embedded status refresh while stream mode is active.

sensor_joy_poll_period_ms.description: Polling period for live joystick sampling when input gating is active.

sensor_pmic_cutoff_mv.description: Battery voltage threshold that triggers forced ISOFET off when guard is enabled.

sensor_pmic_cutoff_hys_mv.description: Hysteresis band above cutoff used to clear low-voltage debounce streaks before latching.

sensor_pmic_cutoff_confirm_samples.description: Number of consecutive low-voltage samples required before forcing ISOFET off.

sensor_pmic_warn_mv.description: Battery voltage threshold for WARN health state.

sensor_pmic_warn_hys_mv.description: Voltage hysteresis for exiting WARN health state.

sensor_pmic_warn_soc_pct.description: SOC threshold for WARN health state.

sensor_pmic_warn_soc_hys_pct.description: SOC hysteresis for exiting WARN health state.

sensor_pmic_crit_soc_pct.description: SOC threshold for CRIT health state.

sensor_pmic_crit_soc_hys_pct.description: SOC hysteresis for exiting CRIT health state.

sensor_lis_low_power_odr.description: LIS ODR used in LOW_POWER profile when step-counter path is inactive.

sensor_lis_low_power_bw.description: LIS BW divider used in LOW_POWER profile when step-counter path is inactive.

sensor_lis_low_power_step_odr.description: LIS ODR used in LOW_POWER profile while step-counter path is active.

sensor_lis_low_power_step_bw.description: LIS BW divider used in LOW_POWER profile while step-counter path is active.

sensor_lis_live_odr.description: LIS ODR used in LIVE profile.

sensor_lis_live_bw.description: LIS BW divider used in LIVE profile.

sensor_lis_step_false_rej_enable.description: Enable LIS false-step rejection in step-counter configuration.

sensor_lis_step_in_fifo_enable.description: Enable LIS step-counter in FIFO mode.

sensor_joy_cal_neutral_window_ms.description: Time window for joystick neutral calibration capture in thSensor.

sensor_joy_cal_neutral_step_ms.description: Sampling cadence for neutral joystick calibration updates.

sensor_joy_cal_direction_window_ms.description: Time window for each directional joystick calibration hold (UP/RIGHT/DOWN/LEFT).

sensor_joy_cal_direction_step_ms.description: Sampling cadence for directional joystick calibration capture.

sensor_joy_cal_sweep_window_ms.description: Time window for joystick sweep calibration capture in thSensor.

sensor_joy_cal_sweep_step_ms.description: Sampling cadence for sweep joystick calibration updates.

sensor_joy_release_stable_samples.description: Consecutive neutral samples required before releasing a held joystick direction.

sensor_joy_digital_release_percent.description: How far the stick must return toward center before a held direction releases. Lower values release earlier; higher values hold longer.

sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_scale_permil.description: Multiplier for measured idle stick noise during neutral calibration. Higher value increases neutral deadzone and reduces drift. 1000 = 1.0x, 2500 = 2.5x.
sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_scale_permil.gui_hint: How much idle stick wobble to ignore. Higher value reduces drift but also reduces fine movement near center.

sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_min_mt_x10.description: Minimum allowed neutral deadzone after calibration. Value is in 0.1 mT steps: 15 = 1.5 mT.
sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_min_mt_x10.gui_hint: Minimum center ignore zone allowed. Used when calibration computes too little filtering.

sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_max_mt_x10.description: Maximum allowed neutral deadzone after calibration. Value is in 0.1 mT steps: 120 = 12.0 mT. Raise this if drift remains at rest.
sensor_joy_neutral_deadzone_max_mt_x10.gui_hint: Maximum center ignore zone allowed. Raise if drift remains; too high can make small movements feel unresponsive.

storage_settings_addr.description: 24-bit flash base address of the raw joystick/settings blob sector (must be 4 KiB aligned).

storage_smoke_addr.description: 24-bit flash address used by storage raw read/write smoke test (must be 4 KiB aligned).

storage_smoke_len.description: Byte count programmed and read back during storage raw smoke test.

storage_fat_base_addr.description: Flash base address of the FAT transport region used by LevelX/FileX (must be 4 KiB aligned).

storage_fat_size_bytes.description: Size of the FAT transport region in bytes (4 KiB aligned).

storage_filex_cache_bytes.description: Static FileX media cache buffer size used by thStorage.

storage_filex_sectors_per_cluster.description: FAT format cluster size in sectors for transport volume formatting.

storage_filex_dir_entries.description: FAT root directory entry count used during transport volume formatting.

rtos_qdisplay_cmd_depth.description: Queue depth for qDisplayCmd owner thread commands.

rtos_qstorage_req_depth.description: Queue depth for qStorageReq owner thread requests.

rtos_qinput_cmd_depth.description: Queue depth for qInputCmd owner thread commands.

rtos_qinput_raw_depth.description: Queue depth for qInputRaw ISR-produced button edge events.

rtos_qui_events_depth.description: Queue depth for qUIEvents logical actions posted by thInput.

rtos_qgame_events_depth.description: Queue depth for qGameEvents logical actions posted by thInput.

input_debounce_ticks.description: Debounce window applied by thInput to raw button edges.

input_repeat_delay_ticks.description: Initial hold delay before thInput emits repeated logical actions (0 disables repeat).

input_repeat_period_ticks.description: Repeat interval for held buttons emitted by thInput (0 disables repeat).

input_repeat_period_stage1_ticks.description: Accelerated repeat interval after stage-1 hold threshold.

input_repeat_period_stage2_ticks.description: Fastest repeat interval after stage-2 hold threshold.

input_repeat_accel_stage1_after_ticks.description: Held duration threshold to switch from base repeat period to stage-1 repeat period.

input_repeat_accel_stage2_after_ticks.description: Held duration threshold to switch from stage-1 repeat period to stage-2 repeat period.

input_joy_repeat_delay_ticks.description: How long the stick must be held before repeating begins. 0 means repeat starts immediately.

input_joy_repeat_period_ticks.description: Base interval between repeated moves while held. Lower = faster repeat. 0 disables repeat.

input_joy_repeat_period_stage1_ticks.description: Interval used after Speedup 1 starts. Lower = faster repeat.

input_joy_repeat_period_stage2_ticks.description: Interval used after Speedup 2 starts (usually fastest). Lower = faster repeat.

input_joy_repeat_accel_stage1_after_tick.description: How long to hold before switching from Base interval to Speedup 1 interval.

input_joy_repeat_accel_stage2_after_tick.description: How long to hold before switching from Speedup 1 interval to Speedup 2 interval.

input_long_press_ticks.description: Hold duration required before thInput emits one long-press event.

input_boot_long_only.description: When enabled, BOOT key emits only long-press action events.

input_realtime_activity_min_ticks.description: Minimum interval between REALTIME input-activity events posted to qSysEvents (0 posts every routed action).

rtos_qaudio_cmd_depth.description: Queue depth for qAudioCmd owner thread commands.

rtos_qsensor_req_depth.description: Queue depth for qSensorReq owner thread requests.

rtos_qsys_events_depth.description: Queue depth for qSysEvents mode/power requests.

rtos_power_wait_ticks.description: Bounded wait timeout used by thPower queue receive loop.

audio_dma_frames.description: Total stereo frame count in the audio DMA test-tone buffer.

audio_sample_rate.description: Audio output sample rate for the SAI pipeline.

audio_test_tone_hz.description: Square-wave frequency used by the audio bring-up test tone.

audio_test_tone_amplitude.description: Peak signed amplitude used for the audio bring-up test tone.

turbo_clock_mhz.description: Target top-end system clock used by performance profiles.

power_perf_hint_stride.description: Post one perf hint every N display presents to bound qSys event rate.
power_perf_hint_stride.gui_hint: How often performance updates are sent. 1 = every frame, 2 = every second frame.

power_perf_frame_budget_ticks.description: Frame-time budget used by thPower perf governor (ticks at KNOB_RTOS_TICK_HZ).
power_perf_frame_budget_ticks.gui_hint: Target frame time budget for power scaling decisions.

power_perf_miss_margin_ticks.description: Margin above frame budget counted as a frame miss for turbo upshift.
power_perf_miss_margin_ticks.gui_hint: Extra time above budget before a frame is treated as slow.

power_perf_headroom_margin_ticks.description: Headroom below frame budget required to count toward downshift from turbo.
power_perf_headroom_margin_ticks.gui_hint: Time below budget required to count as healthy headroom.

power_perf_up_streak_frames.description: Consecutive missed-frame hints required before requesting turbo profile.
power_perf_up_streak_frames.gui_hint: Number of slow frames in a row before increasing performance.

power_perf_down_streak_frames.description: Consecutive headroom hints required before requesting normal profile.
power_perf_down_streak_frames.gui_hint: Number of good frames in a row before reducing performance.

power_perf_min_dwell_ticks.description: Minimum ticks between perf profile switches to prevent oscillation.
power_perf_min_dwell_ticks.gui_hint: Minimum delay before another performance-profile switch is allowed.

debug_swo_enable.description: Compile-time gate for SWO debug instrumentation.
